title: Dental PPO Plans Terminations for Nonpayment, Loss of Eligibility and Group Termination
content:
**Nonpayment.** When the funding billing account lapses for nonpayment, every active Dental PPO Plans enrollment it funds is terminated for nonpayment with a termination date equal to the account's paid-through date (for an individual exchange enrollment with advance premium tax credit, the last day of the first grace month).

**Loss of eligibility.** A child's enrollment ends on the last day of the month in which the child reaches the dependent child age limit birthday. A spouse's or domestic partner's enrollment ends on the last day of the month in which divorce or dissolution is recorded.

**Group termination.** Every enrollment under a group contract ends, with group termination as the reason, on the group contract's termination date.

**Effects.** Termination of an enrollment voids its open estimates, forfeits its rollover balance and ends any orthodontic rider attached to it; claims with a date of service after the termination date are denied as not eligible. Termination of the subscriber's enrollment for nonpayment or group termination also ends the dependents' enrollments funded by the same billing account on the same date.

### Example (hypothetical)
A child whose 26th birthday is 9 October, on a plan whose dependent age limit is 26: the child's enrollment ends on 31 October.
